title: Synthetic source versions invalidate invitation approvals atomically without rewriting drafts
steps: Run source store, fenced sync, approval and HTTP tests with a private PostgreSQL database and bounded timeouts.
expect: source page rollback retains current facts and cursor: all page effects roll back together.
partial negative survives a later failed page: negative remains effective without false source completion.
same-dependency refresh after an expired validation gap invalidates permanently: fresh facts never revive stale approval.
source sync before approve rejects stale campaign revision: the waiting approval gets HTTP 409.
source sync after approve invalidates before commit: effective approval is false and original text remains.
source read cannot combine different fact and approval snapshots: concurrent GET never exposes a mixed effective tuple.
legacy STOP invalidates linked source approvals without touching customized text: suppression crosses the shared alias graph.
source save invalidates approval and explicit reapproval permits only synthetic simulation: attempts remain immutable and no real mail is sent.
source content preview matches the generated draft personalization: preview and generated subject/body use the same source facts.
source admission refuses campaign 101 without blocking existing sync or legacy STOP: bounded enrollment preserves existing operations.
fence: Synthetic identities only; real private PostgreSQL transactions and observed advisory lock waiters, no live source or mailbox transport.
